From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@zenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — 30m product demo (proposed times for ZenHealth)

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for patient-facing summaries, cut per-request cost by ~30% via batching/caching, and ensure data residency controls for PHI.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Tom (CTO) and your Head of Product (Lydia).

Per our agreement, Id like to schedule a 30-minute product demo + brief technical Q&A where we can: walk through the Redwood runtime, discuss routing/policy options, and show a sample latency/cost breakdown for an LLM inference flow.

Proposed 30-minute time windows (all PT):
1) Wed 2027-06-16 — 09:30–10:00 PT
2) Thu 2027-06-17 — 11:00–11:30 PT
3) Mon 2027-06-21 — 15:00–15:30 PT

If none of those work, share 2–3 times that fit your stakeholders and well adjust. Ill include a short agenda (attached) and bring Marissa from Customer Success to map post-demo next steps.

Attachments: redwood-30m-demo-agenda.pdf, zenhealth-discovery-notes.docx (internal reference)

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
